The '''Mist Patrol''' was a military division of the [[Hapan Royal Navy]].

==Overview==
This part of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium's]] Navy was tasked with patrolling the boundaries of the [[Transitory Mists]] where they searched for intruders that invaded their territory in the years after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

After the [[Battle of Kuat (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kuat]] and the [[Second Battle of Fondor]], the Mist Patrol agreed to keep the secret of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] base on [[Shedu Maad]].
